thread:
Maya: Quick ping — PR #8423 is ready for a security sweep. Small change to how we mount customer Vault paths into the private VPC sidecar. Need eyes for secrets exposure and whether we need any VPC egress updates. Plan to merge tomorrow morning unless flagged.

Frank: Can you drop the key diff or the lines that touch secrets?

Maya: Sure, here's the relevant bit:
```yaml
containers:
  - name: sidecar
    env:
      - name: VAULT_PATH
        value: "secret/data/customers/{{CUSTOMER_ID}}"
      - name: VAULT_ROLE
        valueFrom:
          secretKeyRef:
            name: vault-role
            key: role
```
No hardcoded secrets, just a change to the path template + using the existing `vault-role` secret.

security-bot: Automated scan: no plaintext secrets detected. Note: PR introduces a broader IAM permission in the SecretAccessor role than previous — flagged for manual review.

Samuel: Does this require any new cross-account networking or new outbound destinations? If it's still hitting the vault endpoint via the VPC endpoint it shouldn't need firewall changes, but want to confirm.

Olga: I'll take this. Quick asks: 1) add a short docs blurb about rotation/least-privilege for the new path, 2) add a tiny test that exercises permission failure (so we don't regress), and 3) scope the role to the namespace if possible. If those are added I can LGT M.

Maya: Got it — I'll add docs + test. Moving merge window to 13:00 PT to give time for updates.

Frank: Happy to review once you push.

Maya: Pushed updates: tightened role (removed wildcard resource), added `tests/test_vault_mount.py` with a negative-case, and a short doc in `docs/security/vault-usage.md`. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8423

Olga: Skimmed the changes, left one comment about the condition on the role (minor). Everything else looks good from a privacy/surface perspective. :+1:

security-bot: Policy re-check: CI policy passes except for the one role condition comment (non-blocking).

Maya: Addressed the condition in role, pushed again. Thanks for the catch.

Olga: LGTM from security side — marking as approved. :white_check_mark:

Frank: LGTM as well, will merge after CI completes.

deploy-bot: Merge scheduled by workflow: merge queued, will run at 2026-03-18T20:00:00Z if CI green.

Maya: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick reviews!
